text:
anya: quick idea 111 add a bandit-style perf sampler in onboarding to keep cost low but catch regressions. run a golden-anchor (tiny) always, mid-warmup always, and bandit-sample long runs. budget cap per-org to avoid runaway cost. thoughts? :thinking:
chris: like it. call out signals: p50/p95, tokens_per_sec, kv_warmup_delta. outcomes should be: ABI_OK / ABI_FAIL / PERF_OK / PERF_WARN / PERF_FAIL so infra can map to actions.
tejas: bandit sampler should base prob on model_bytes and recent churn. formula: p_long = clamp(0.04 * (1/sqrt(size_gb)) * churn_factor, 0.002, 0.25). also require a deterministic seed per job for reproducibility.
lina: add per-team budget cap and a daily quota. infra should stop sampling if quota hit and mark sample as SKIPPED_QUOTA. also store a compact trace: {abi_hash, qtype, p50, p95, tps} as metadata.
marco: ops policy: ABI_FAIL -> block admission. PERF_FAIL -> halt canary and alert SRE. PERF_WARN -> tag and schedule followup bench. don't auto-rollback unless team opts in.
anya: propose small manifest snippet to include in model.yaml: perf_sampler_enabled: true; golden_anchor: seq32; mid: seq256 warmup=2 repeats=3; long: seq1024 warmup=3 repeats=4 sample=bandit. plus budget and thresholds references.
chris: infra 1 add est_gpu_minutes per job and per-check breakdown so product can show cost impact. also emit reason codes in job events.
infra-bot: perf-sampler job queued: perf-sampler/2755559999 on rdx-dedicated-5  status=queued  est_gpu_minutes=4.2
tejas: also log a rolling baseline anchor per-model-version so we compare against the correct baseline (not global).
anya: i'll draft RFC and include the manifest example, bandit formula, quota behavior, and a small spreadsheet for thresholds. will ping for review.
